items.prompt: A wide Bishkek avenue in late autumn: Soviet apartment blocks, bare poplars, a few people walking, and behind the city the wall of snow-capped Tian Shan mountains rising very close and very high.

alt.ru: Широкий проспект Бишкека поздней осенью: советские дома, голые тополя, редкие прохожие, а за городом совсем близко встают снежные горы.
alt.en: A wide Bishkek avenue in late autumn: Soviet blocks, bare poplars, a few passers-by, and snowy mountains rising very close behind the city.
alt.pt: Uma larga avenida de Bishkek no fim do outono: prédios soviéticos, choupos nus, poucos transeuntes e montanhas nevadas muito perto atrás da cidade.
alt.es: Una amplia avenida de Biskek a finales de otoño: bloques soviéticos, álamos desnudos, pocos transeúntes y montañas nevadas muy cerca tras la ciudad.

items.prompt: A worn yellow paperback lying on a bare wooden shelf in an otherwise empty room, its spine cracked and pages swollen from years of travel, lit by a single beam from a window. No readable text.

alt.ru: Потрёпанная жёлтая книжка в мягкой обложке на пустой деревянной полке, корешок треснул, страницы разбухли; на неё падает луч из окна.
alt.en: A worn yellow paperback on an empty wooden shelf, spine cracked and pages swollen, lit by a beam from a window.
alt.pt: Um livro de bolso amarelo gasto numa prateleira de madeira vazia, lombada estalada e páginas inchadas, iluminado por um raio de janela.
alt.es: Un libro de bolsillo amarillo gastado en un estante de madera vacío, el lomo agrietado y las páginas hinchadas, iluminado por un rayo de la ventana.
